self_review.method: Author checked headline-bound wording, semantic source windows, actual versus preview status, card dates and units, investment triggers and consistency. This is not an independent review receipt.
self_review.timing: All completed outcomes precede 00:00 UTC on October 7. US inflation, bank earnings, Tesla robotaxi presentation and the US election remain pending. Older previews with available results are not used as current pending results. Japanese and Chinese prior-month releases are baseline context, not report-day actuals.
self_review.market_discipline: Own-session Yahoo source tags; Shanghai September 30 is separate from October 4 liquid ETFs and Hong Kong. Crypto uses October 6 completed UTC daily candle. Treasury percentages and bps from official curve. No numeric spot-FX quotes or returns; DXY allowed. No WDC or CMCSA nominal levels.
self_review.claims: All cited facts limited to own-date headlines; analysis, scenarios and allocation mechanics stated conditionally. No invented ownership, measured flows, posts or article-body details.
self_review.citation_room: Maximum two nonretail uses per citation leaves room for separate retail merger.
